data.name: Wiz_Step4_Detail
data.value: Save it and send it back

data.name: Wiz_Sub_Welcome
data.value: This program checks whether the scanner works with the new driver. Nothing on the computer is changed and the scanner is not taken apart.

data.name: Wiz_Sub_Running
data.value: The scanner is checked step by step. This takes less than a minute.

data.name: Wiz_Sub_Questions
data.value: The computer cannot answer these on its own - someone has to look at the scanner.

data.name: Wiz_Sub_Results
data.value: Save the report and send it back. It is the only way to see what passed on your machine and what did not.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_Step1
data.value: Recognises the scanner and reads its settings. Nothing moves.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_Step2
data.value: Switches the lamp on and checks whether that shows up in the settings.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_Step3
data.value: Takes a few test images, at several resolutions.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_Step4
data.value: Asks two questions the computer cannot answer.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_Before_1
data.value: The scanner should be switched on and connected with the USB cable. Close the lid and leave the glass empty - the test images use the calibration strips at the edge of the glass.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_Before_2
data.value: The program changes nothing on the computer and installs no driver. If something does not pass, the report will say so - the scanner will not be damaged by it.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_NoScanner_Hint
data.value: Runs the same checks against the simulator. It is there so the program can be tried out before it is sent.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_HowFar_Hint
data.value: Higher means more thorough. A package may carry a lower ceiling, and then the higher levels are skipped - that is not an error.

data.name: Wiz_Welcome_HowLong_Hint
data.value: Less than a minute. The check can be stopped at any moment, and the scanner is left in a sound state.

data.name: Wiz_Running_Hint
data.value: The scanner is being tested. Do not unplug the cable while this lasts.

data.name: Wiz_Running_Waiting

data.name: Wiz_Running_Empty_Detail

data.name: Wiz_Questions_Hint
